source_census_scope.normalization: Strip template slots/tags/comments and SVG/script/style bodies; decode HTML entities; collapse presentation whitespace; ignore decorative leading middle-dot/trailing arrow and punctuation-only units.
source_census_scope.includes: Every lexical fixed text node in chrome, colophon and all fourteen section partials. Additional fixed accessibility labels, capability enum labels and directory labels are individually source-located.
source_census_scope.excludes: CSS, structural markup, decorative glyphs, generated namespace slots, runtime mechanics and JSON-LD semantics belong to their separate contracts. No arbitrary source markup is copied into the compiler.
